company.name: Mindstate Design Labs
company.shortDescription: Programmable biology platform for psychoactive effect design
company.description:
Mindstate Design Labs is building the closed-loop science & engineering stack for rational psychoactive effect design.

The company’s molecular-experience interface links molecular biology to the human psychopharmacodynamic profile to convert informal constructs like clarity, presence, or motivation into high-dimensional design targets.

Its clinical program is a sequence of human demonstrations that psychoactive effects can be decomposed, recombined, and synthesized. The first controlled study decomposed hallucinations from the broader hallucinogen profile; the next is designed to selectively upregulate aesthetic salience to treat anhedonia in major depressive disorder.

Founded by the Dr. Tom Ray, creator of programmable evolution, and Dillan DiNardo, a biotech investor & serial operator who previously founded platforms in programmable genes, proteins, and cells. Backed by the founders, CEOs, and founding investors of the companies that built frontier AI & biology (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepMind, Neuralink, Valo, Y Combinator) and new category infrastructure (Coinbase, Instacart, AngelList, Twitch).
company.headquarters: South San Francisco, California, United States

aiResearchSummary.text: Mindstate Design Labs is engaged in developing therapeutic combinations, compositions, and methods for designing and producing treatments that elicit an entactogenic mindstate. Their research focuses on compositions comprising imidazoline receptor agents, cannabinoid receptor agents, and serotonin receptor agents, as described in the disclosed therapeutic combinations for modulating specific neuroreceptors. These activities highlight their focus on psychedelic-inspired therapeutics.
